_fit_rule: Big general boards (Adzuna, Job Bank, City of Toronto, U of T) are matched on the JOB TITLE only - their descriptions are full of boilerplate that mis-tagged buyers, data architects and IT techs. Niche environmental boards (WorkCabin RSS) may also match on the description. Unfit titles are dropped by TITLE_BLOCK / TITLE_BLOCK_2 in scripts/fetch-jobs.mjs.
_comment: Edit this file to add/remove job sources. No code changes needed. After editing, the next scheduled GitHub Action run picks it up (or run it manually from the Actions tab).
_hard_rule: max_days_old is a hard cap - the fetcher DROPS anything older, on every source, because expired postings can't be detected reliably. Keep it at 7 unless you have a reason.
_open_rule: Exception to the 7-day cap: a posting that is KNOWN to still be open (it states a future closing date, or comes from a board that removes expired listings, e.g. WorkCabin) is kept up to max_days_open days.
_configured_for: Environmental technician / ecological restoration / GIS / field & lab roles, plus educational-assistant & science-teaching roles, in the Toronto / GTA area, transit-accessible (no personal vehicle).
_vehicle_rule: The site owner drives (Ontario G2) but has no vehicle of their own. The fetcher flags a job only if its text requires the applicant's OWN vehicle ('own/personal/reliable vehicle', 'access to a vehicle', 'provide your own transportation') OR a FULL Class G licence (not G2). The site hides flagged jobs by default. A plain 'valid driver's licence', 'G2 acceptable', crew transport, or a provided company/fleet vehicle is NOT flagged.
_relocation_rule: Updated 2026-10-26: the owner is now open to leaving Toronto. GTA jobs are listed first; jobs anywhere else in Canada (permanent AND seasonal/contract) appear in a 'Worth moving for' section, permanent first. Education jobs outside the GTA are still left out of that section.

sources.note: CONFIRMED WORKING (2026-09-01). Canada's aggregator - pulls from Jobillico, CareerBeacon, direct employers, some government. One request per search term. NOTE: the RSS feed only returns the ~13 most recent postings per term (no pagination), so on a 6-hourly schedule it captures new jobs as they appear but a cold start only sees the last day or two. No closing dates in the feed - these jobs rely on the 7-day cap. Lots of Quebec results for generic terms; the site filters by location client-side.

Free API, big coverage + salary data. Register at https://developer.adzuna.com/signup and add ADZUNA_APP_ID / ADZUNA_APP_KEY as GitHub repo secrets. Skipped automatically if the secrets are missing - everything else still runs.

SWITCHED TO THE API (2026-10-14). Canada's conservation & wildlife jobs board. The old RSS feed only gave a coarse region ('Central Canada') and the 10 newest postings, so almost everything got dropped (10 raw -> 1 kept). The WP Job Manager REST API gives the real city ('Trenton, ON', 'Woodbridge, ON') and every live listing. WorkCabin removes filled/expired listings itself, so its postings are kept up to max_days_open even when older than 7 days. Falls back to feed_url if the API breaks.

ADDED 2026-10-14. City of Toronto careers (SAP SuccessFactors) keyword RSS. Carries 'Posting End Date' -> real closing dates. Parks, Forestry & Recreation, Toronto Water, Environment & Climate. Matched on job title only (descriptions all mention 'Parks, Forestry & Recreation').

ADDED 2026-10-14. U of T careers (SAP SuccessFactors) keyword RSS. Carries 'Closing Date' -> real closing dates. St. George, Mississauga and Scarborough campuses. Faculty posts (professor) are filtered out.

ADDED 2026-10-26. Every federal public-service job open to the public (Parks Canada, Fisheries and Oceans, Environment and Climate Change Canada, Natural Resources Canada, Agriculture Canada, …) - ~400 postings, 20 per page, all pages read each run. Real closing dates. No posted date on the list, so a job's date is the first run that saw it. Matched on job title only. Student jobs (FSWEP) are a separate system and not included.
Not possible: gojobs.gov.on.ca sends scripts to a Radware CAPTCHA (bot protection), checked 2026-10-26. Covers MNR / MECP jobs. Use its free email job alerts instead: gojobs.gov.on.ca/JobsAlert.aspx.

Not possible: TRCA's Dayforce careers API refuses requests without a logged-in browser session (checked 2026-09-03). TRCA jobs usually also appear on WorkCabin / GoodWork / Job Bank, which are scanned.

Public Greenhouse boards, one slug per org (the <slug> in job-boards.greenhouse.io/<slug>). Wrong slugs are skipped silently. Check whether your target ENGOs / research institutes use Greenhouse before adding.

CONFIRMED WORKING (2026-09-08). Canada's largest environmental / conservation / sustainability board. No public feed - a dedicated HTML scraper (type 'goodwork' in fetch-jobs.mjs) reads the server-rendered listing pages (/jobs, /jobs/2, /jobs/3). Each row carries title, org, city, and a real 'Date posted'. No per-job closing date. Fragile by nature: if GoodWork restyles the listing page the scraper needs updating - it will show as 'failing' in the site's source panel if that happens. Strong local coverage: TRCA, Credit Valley, Ontario Nature, EcoSpark, Earth Rangers, Metcalf Foundation.

CONFIRMED WORKING (2026-09-08). ECO Canada's environmental job board. No public feed - dedicated HTML scraper (type 'ecoworks') reads the server-rendered listing pages (/jobs?page=N). Rows carry title, employer, type, location, sometimes salary, and a relative 'Nd ago' posted date. Same fragility caveat as GoodWork.
